name: VANZO
recent: VANZO 近期宣布每股 0.4 仙的首次中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 12 日，派发日为 11 月 27 日。同时，多名董事及大股东在 10 月底至 11 月初申报了股份交易，包括董事 Choe Sook Ling 间接减持 500 万股及 Wong Liang Tzer 间接增持。近期没有重要公告或新闻。
notable: 宣布首次中期股息每股 0.4 仙，除息日 2026 年 11 月 12 日，派发日 11 月 27 日。
董事 Choe Sook Ling 间接减持 500 万股（1.071%），交易日期 2026 年 11 月 3 日。
董事 Wong Liang Tzer 间接增持 75,000 股（0.016%），交易日期 2026 年 11 月 11 日。
risks: 董事 Choe Sook Ling 在闭门期间接减持 500 万股。
多名董事及大股东在近期频繁申报股份交易。

recent_en: VANZO recently declared a first interim dividend of 0.4 sen per share, with ex-date on 12 Nov 2026 and payment date on 27 Nov 2026. Meanwhile, several directors and substantial shareholders reported share dealings in late Oct to early Nov, including director Choe Sook Ling's indirect disposal of 5 million shares and Wong Liang Tzer's indirect acquisition. There is no other important announcement or news recently.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.4 sen per share, ex-date 12 Nov 2026, payment date 27 Nov 2026.
Director Choe Sook Ling indirectly disposed 5,000,000 shares (1.071%) on 3 Nov 2026.
Director Wong Liang Tzer indirectly acquired 75,000 shares (0.016%) on 11 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Director Choe Sook Ling indirectly disposed 5 million shares during the closed period.
Several directors and substantial shareholders have frequently reported share dealings recently.
